Good to know

Questions / answered.

Are these physical patterns?

No. The Etsy listings shown here are digital downloads. Nothing is shipped. Check each listing for its exact file formats and included instructions.

How do I choose a size?

Use the size chart on the specific Etsy listing and compare the finished garment measurements with a similar garment you like. Size ranges vary by design.

Can I print at home?

Available formats vary, but the featured listings include common home and copy-shop formats. Always print the test square at 100% before assembling pages.

Do you offer custom pattern work?

Custom drafting is available through the Etsy shop. Share the garment concept, intended fabric, and required sizing in your Etsy message.

About

PatternHub is a fashion journal and digital pattern studio for sewists, costume makers, and independent creators. The shop focuses on professionally drafted garments and statement silhouettes, while the journal explores styling, fabric, fit, and construction.
